about.title: A CS student who ships real apps
paragraphs: I'm in the 7th semester of B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering at Dr. Sudhir Chandra Sur Institute of Technology, MAKAUT, in Kolkata.

Most of what I know I learned by building things people can use. DropNet started as a this-should-be-simple file transfer idea and turned into months of debugging socket handshakes. Now I'm teaching a phone to run AI models without a server.

projects.title: Projects

items.title: DropNet
items.summary: Send files between your own devices over Wi-Fi, with no internet and no accounts
items.description: A cross-platform file transfer app for Android, Windows, Linux, macOS and iOS. Devices find each other on the local network and talk directly, and a browser portal lets a device receive files without installing anything.
highlights: Direct device-to-device transfers over the local network

items.title: UltraVision
items.summary: AI that runs on your phone, not on a server
items.description: An on-device AI gallery for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux. Chat with nine Marvel-inspired personas, search photos as you type, find moments in videos, transcribe audio and upscale images, with every model running locally.
highlights: Nine personas, each with its own offline voice
CLIP photo and video search, Whisper transcription, llama.cpp chat
Model Marketplace with RAM-fit hints and verified downloads
items.note: Not public yet. It will be released soon.

items.title: FetchNet
items.summary: Paste a link, pick a quality, done
items.description: A downloader for video, audio and images on Android and Windows. It is a clean interface for the open-source tools yt-dlp and gallery-dl, with everything they need bundled on Android.
highlights: Video from 144p to 4K, or audio as MP3, M4A or the original stream
Galleries and posts from Instagram, X, Reddit and more
Links shared from other Android apps open straight in it

items.title: DropNet-CLI
items.summary: DropNet's terminal companion, in pure Python
items.description: Sends any file to another device on the same network from the command line. It runs on Windows, Linux, macOS and Termux on Android.
highlights: Finds receivers through a UDP beacon, or sends to a known IP
Optional Fernet encryption with a 6-character session code
SHA-256 and CRC32 checks on every transfer
